summary: Entry-level retail sales associate with roughly three years of experience across sales floor, cash handling, and restaurant hospitality roles. Skilled in merchandising, product placement, inventory control, POS and cash register operation, and credit card transactions, with a focus on customer service and upselling. Holds fashion industry knowledge and food service experience including ServSafe and CPR/AED certifications. Brings a team-oriented, fast-paced retail and hospitality profile suited to store-level sales and customer-facing roles.
